svg.text: SECTION A-A, FRONT TO BACK ON THE CENTRE LINE, 1:1
SECTION B-B, SIDE TO SIDE ON THE CENTRE LINE, 1:1
Section planes A-A and B-B are the two centre lines of the plan on ESP25-GA-01.
1. At the dose time the buzzer (28) sounds and the
light (26) flashes beside the PRESS HERE button (29).
2. The patient presses the button: the motor (13)
turns the worm (15) 4 times, the gear (7) 4 teeth
3. The next compartment comes over the drop hole and
the pills fall down the chute (4) into the drawer (36).
4. The drop sensors (5) see them fall; the alarm stops.
5. The home sensor (16) under the gear sees the hole
in it once a turn: the position is checked every turn.
the carousel cannot be turned by hand to the next dose.
WBEP Ltd for the health trust
Third angle projection. Drawn from the CAD model with hidden line removal.
